checks: npm run e2e (Playwright, headless system Chrome, stubbed GitHub client, no writes)
npm run e2e:live (Playwright, headless system Chrome, read-only against the real dev app)
delivery: npm/npx launch of a tagged revision, e.g. npx --yes github:normzhou/yolo-blank-canvas#v0.1.1; GET /api/version reports serverBuild/clientBuild
recovery: Proposed: diagnose, retry on new evidence, change approach, replan, wait/defer or propose governing changes; repair the lowest sufficient layer without expanding the grant
limits: L1 checks run by the harness (`npm test`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run build`, `npm run e2e`, `npm run e2e:live`) plus the GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/ci.yml, which runs `npm test` and `npx tsc --noEmit` on pull requests and pushes to main. The E2E runs require system Google Chrome (channel 'chrome') and the live run requires an authenticated `gh`; neither is a CI gate

Because the chain reaches the original baseline and published reports are not rewritten, the `checkpoint` rule cannot pass until the publisher fix.
